No password appears in SQL file. Usage documented in file header showing docker exec command with -v parameter. Tested with environment variable KC_DB_PASSWORD successfully.

completion_promises.criterion_text: The script includes/documents the least-privilege proof: the keycloak role is denied SELECT on study_tutor learner tables and can reach only its own keycloak database
completion_promises.evidence: Turn 1 implemented least-privilege in section 3: REVOKE ALL from PUBLIC on both databases, GRANT CONNECT only to owning roles, explicit REVOKE ALL cross-database access. Section 4 includes verification queries showing privilege isolation. Section 5 documents negative proof command. Tested: psql -U keycloak -d study_tutor returns 'FATAL: permission denied for database study_tutor'.
